_meta.note: Starter registry for the Data Rights Request Generator. contactType 'url' = a self-serve privacy portal the company publishes; 'email' = a published privacy-request address; 'unknown' = no public direct contact found, use the company's own published privacy contact. Every entry carries a lastChecked date.
_meta.openFlag: OPEN FLAG: the exact top-N list and per-company privacy contacts need a full verification pass. These are publicly-documented seeds, most confirmed via a 2026-07-02 web pass; confirm before treating any single contact as authoritative. Oracle and Epsilon were not re-confirmed in that pass.

companies.name: Google
companies.notes: For portability, Google Takeout exports your data. Deep-link pattern: https://takeout.google.com/settings/takeout/custom/<products>?dest=<drive|onedrive|dropbox|box>&frequency=<1_time|2_months> — <products> is a comma-separated list of data-ids (e.g. google_account,my_activity,youtube). Base picker: https://takeout.google.com/

companies.name: Meta / Facebook
companies.notes: Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information.

companies.name: Instagram
companies.notes: Managed via Meta Accounts Center, same flow as Facebook.
